thread:
zara: FYI hit a nasty edge during onboarding where two devs ran `redwoodctl auth login` at the same time on a shared workstation and we ended up with a broken profiles.json. looks like we don't have file locking for profiles.
ben: oh no. what did the file look like?
zara: it was truncated and had interleaved JSON like `{"current":"dev"}{"profiles":...` so the parser failed with EJSONPARSE and the CLI started falling back to an empty in-memory profile set.
carla: ugh. is this during local testing with `local-serve`? we've seen races when CI runners reuse a workspace and concurrent logins happen.
zara: yep local-serve + two shells. repro steps:
```
# shell A
redwoodctl auth login --profile team-a
# shell B (quickly)
redwoodctl auth login --profile team-b
# both callbacks finish nearly simultaneously
```
locksmith-bot: detected concurrent write attempt to sources:profiles.json (no lock) -> recommend advisory: add process-level advisory lock.
ben: current storage is simple writeFileAtomic but no flock. we should add an exclusive file lock (flock on *nix, CreateFile with exclusive flag on Windows) or use an append-and-rename with a write lock.
carla: also add a small recovery heuristic for corrupted JSON: if parse fails, try to validate by attempting to split on `}{` and salvage last-good object and log a telemetry event. avoid silent overwrite.
zara: advantage would be fewer support emergencies when people do quick demos in the same workspace. it bit us in a session with a new hire.
ben: I'll open a PR to add cross-platform advisory locking in our config library and a crash-safe writer with temp-file+rename. also add a unit test that spawns two login processes concurrently in the runner.
carla: follow-up: update the CLI to detect parse failure and print actionable advice instead of "No profiles found" — something like: "Profile storage corrupted. Please run `redwoodctl profiles recover` or set REDWOOD_CONFIG_DIR to an empty directory to retry. A recovery attempt was logged to diagnostics."
locksmith-bot: created ticket #8122 "redwoodctl: add file locking + safe-write for profiles.json; add recovery path" and suggested label `devex:cli`.
devex-bot: created issue #8122 and added labels `devex:cli`, `platform:storage`; assigned to @ben. :white_check_mark:
zara: also adding a short support KB note with quick recovery commands:
```
# emergency recover
cp ~/.config/redwood/profiles.json ~/.config/redwood/profiles.json.bak
redwoodctl profiles list || redwoodctl profiles recover
```
ben: I'll include a recovery subcommand in the PR and mock the concurrent-login in the integration suite.
carla: thanks — this will reduce a lot of noisy tickets during onboarding workshops. :raised_hands:
